messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "throw away unused suspension 30 days after made up"
set: ["throw away unused suspension 30 days after made up", "throw away any unused concentrated solution 90 days after first opening the bottle", "throw away any unused oral solution 20 days after first opening the bottle", "discard any unused liquid older than 30 days", "discard after 21 days at room temperature if unused", "discard unused liquid in trash after 60 days of opening bottle", "after five days", "throw away any liquid medicine not used within 14 days after it was mixed at the pharmacy", "suspension", "drowsiness may go away after a few days of treatment", "take 30 minutes after dinner", "requirement applies after at least 30 days on 7 mg dose", "patients can start Rybelsus up to 7 days after last injection", "discard pen including unused medicine after 4 doses", "discard the pen 30 days after first use, even if medicine remains", "increase occurs after at least 30 days on the 4 mg dose"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
